[client] No web screen links here (the cart's address card and checkout go to /profile/addresses); the page is reachable by address only. Link it from the address card's Change, or retire it.
[backend] Answers 200 with null for an unknown id and has no ownership error; the client treats only a returned address with is_default true as saved.
